nodes.text: There’s no need to panic about the reported cases of #humanmetapneumovirus (HMPV). This commonly occurring virus causes respiratory illnesses and belongs to the same family as the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). In SA, HMPV is detected as one of the normal respiratory viruses. https://t.co/xnj7SL1emg

nodes.text: @nicd_sa Well ll, I wasn't panicking before. Now I feel like I've been introduced to a new coworker who says "Hi I'm Dave. Don't worry, I'm not a murderer" 🤣
